SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS "orders.size_class",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.orders"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), _cm_orders___count_partition_by_order_date AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders._count_partition_by_order_date"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base."orders.size_class",
    _base."orders.order_date",
    _base."orders.orders",
    _base."orders.orders" / NULLIF(
      COALESCE(
        _cm_orders___count_partition_by_order_date."orders._count_partition_by_order_date",
        0
      ),
      0
    ) AS "orders.share",
    COALESCE(
      _cm_orders___count_partition_by_order_date."orders._count_partition_by_order_date",
      0
    ) AS "orders._count_partition_by_order_date"
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_orders___count_partition_by_order_date
    ON _base."orders.order_date" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders___count_partition_by_order_date."orders.order_date"
), shifted__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END AS "orders.size_class",
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    COUNT(*) AS "orders.orders"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    CASE WHEN orders.amount > 100 THEN 'big' ELSE 'small' END,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), sjoin__time_shift_inner AS (
  SELECT
    base."orders.size_class",
    base."orders.order_date",
    base."orders.orders",
    base."orders.share",
    base."orders._count_partition_by_order_date",
    shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.orders" AS "orders._time_shift_inner"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted__time_shift_inner
    ON base."orders.size_class" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.size_class"
    AND base."orders.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 MONTH IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted__time_shift_inner."orders.order_date"
), step1 AS (
  SELECT
    "orders.size_class",
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.orders",
    "orders.share",
    "orders._count_partition_by_order_date",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.orders" - "orders._time_shift_inner" AS "orders.change_vs_prev_month"
  FROM sjoin__time_shift_inner
)
SELECT
  "orders.size_class",
  "orders.order_date",
  "orders.orders",
  "orders.share",
  "orders.change_vs_prev_month"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.size_class",
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.orders",
    "orders.share",
    "orders._count_partition_by_order_date",
    "orders._time_shift_inner",
    "orders.change_vs_prev_month"
  FROM step1
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  "orders.order_date" ASC,
  "orders.size_class" ASC
LIMIT 21

args.message:
In Q1 2025, small orders (amount of 100 or less) made up most of each month's orders, between 81% and 88%. March had the highest share of big orders, at about 19%.

| Month | Class | Orders | Share of month | Change vs. previous month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2025-01 | big | 21 | 0.1320754716981132 | -11 |
| 2025-01 | small | 138 | 0.8679245283018868 | +24 |
| 2025-02 | big | 18 | 0.125 | -3 |
| 2025-02 | small | 126 | 0.875 | -12 |
| 2025-03 | big | 28 | 0.1917808219178082 | +10 |
| 2025-03 | small | 118 | 0.8082191780821918 | -8 |

- **Classification:** 'big' means an amount over 100; everything else is 'small'. An order with no amount would count as 'small'. I added this class only inside the query, so the stored data model is unchanged.
- **January's change** is measured against December 2024.
- **Share** is the class's orders divided by all orders in that month.
